en.t: He also prepared another letter, explaining his innermost feelings in detail.
To avoid becoming tedious, this is omitted here.

units.source_text: 源氏公子的使者已归去，后来空蝉特派小君传送单衫的答诗：

en.t: Prince Genji's messenger had already gone back, and later Utsusemi specially sent Kogimi to deliver her reply poem for the unlined robe:
